# Introduction

{{"of":"self"}} is an online music producer. Starting in 2018, he has created more than 50 tracks comprising mostly electronic synth.

He has generously provided {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_stars"}} permission to include his track *{{"of":"minecraft:item / to_stars:music_disc_gravitational_influence","text":"Gravitational Influence"}}* as a {{"of":"to_base:concept / minecraft:music_disc","text":"music disc"}}.

His recent songs are available to listen to on [Soundcloud](https://soundcloud.com/k3ylet).
